pack.name: The Ages of the Vale
pack.summary: War-torn plains made into a kingdom by treaties; court wizards whose gifts grow every season until their great working wakes the mountain; if nobody stops it, ash and fire end the world, and the next runs are the ash tribe's: digging the kingdom's ruins, and a fallen star whose people build a strange city where it fell.

factions.name: the Court Wizards
factions.text: Learned men and women of the tower who serve the crown, and their own ambition more.

factions.name: the Star-Folk
factions.text: Pale, tall people who walked out of the fallen star. Nobody knows their tongue.

leaders.name: Chief Cinder
leaders.line: Chief of the ash tribe. Few hands, little to build with, a grey world to dig.
leaders.hint: A people who live in the ashes of a fire nobody stopped.

leaders.name: Speaker Oru
leaders.line: The one who learned the Star-Folk's tongue. The run is played from their city.
leaders.hint: Someone has to kneel to whatever falls from the sky.

tags.meaning: The town is the seat of a kingdom.
The ash tribe lives in the ruins.
Iron that fell from the sky.

things.name: The royal court
things.text: Banners of the Kingdom of the Vale over the keep. Sworn towns send their tribute here.

things.name: The wizards' college
things.text: The court wizards' rooms in the old tower. Their gifts grow every season, and so do their plans.

things.name: The ash camp
things.text: Tents of grey cloth among the ruins. The tribe lives on what it digs up.

cards.title: A star falls past {town}
cards.pitch: Something burning came down in the hills past {town} last night. It did not fall like a stone. Send riders to find it. 1 Intel.

if_taken.say: The riders found a ship of bright metal, split open in a burned crater past {town}. It is on your map.

if_expires.say: Nobody went. The burned crater past {town} is on the travellers' maps anyway.

cards.art: A cracked silver hull in a smoking crater among dark hills at night, painterly.

cards.title: The old temple on the node
cards.pitch: There is a ruined temple out on the moor where the old power comes up through the ground. Rebuild its altar and it will feed our wizards. 2 Materials.

if_taken.say: The altar is raised again on the moor. Its power comes to your wizards each season.

if_expires.say: The temple on the moor stays a ruin.

cards.art: A ring of broken pillars on a moor, blue light rising from the stones, painterly.

cards.title: Make peace with {town}
cards.pitch: The plains have burned for ten years. {town} is tired of it. Send gifts and a treaty and it will swear to us.

if_taken.say: {town} signs the peace and swears to you. Its wagons come to your market.

if_expires.say: The war goes on. Raiders take {town}.

cards.art: Envoys under white banners meeting on a burned plain, painterly.

cards.title: Proclaim the Kingdom of the Vale
cards.pitch: Two towns swear to you already. Put on a crown, and every town on the plains will know whose peace this is.

if_taken.say: You are crowned in the market. The plains are a kingdom.

if_expires.say: The towns go back to their own lords and their old feuds.

cards.art: A crowning in a crowded market square, banners, painterly.

cards.title: Invite the court wizards
cards.pitch: A kingdom needs wizards. Give them the old tower and they will give you Magic every season.

if_taken.say: Robed wizards move into the tower. Lights burn there all night.

if_expires.say: The wizards go to another court.

cards.art: Robed wizards carrying books up an old tower stair, painterly.

cards.title: Learn the court's fire ward
cards.pitch: The old kings kept a ward against the mountain's fire. I can teach it to you. Cast it over the houses and lava runs round them. 2 Materials.

if_taken.say: You can raise the Fire ward when lava comes.

if_expires.say: The keeper locks his book away again.

cards.art: An old keeper tracing a glowing circle on a tower floor, painterly.

cards.title: The mountain spits fire
cards.pitch: The wizards' first working has cracked the mountain. Lava is coming down toward the town. Ward the houses if you can.

success.say: The lava ran round the town and set black in the fields. Every house stands.

cost.say: The lava took a few streets before it set. Steam off the rock brings a storm down on the town.

failure.say: The lava ran through the town. Whole streets are under black rock. Steam off it brings a storm down on the town.

cards.art: A tongue of lava coming down a hillside toward a walled town at dusk, painterly.

cards.title: The wizards' great working
cards.pitch: The wizards are waking the mountain to make the kingdom a god. The ground shakes. Break their circle now, whatever it costs.

if_taken.say: You break their circle. The mountain goes back to sleep. The wizards curse your name.

if_expires.name: Ash and flame: the wizards woke the mountain

if_expires.say: The mountain opens. Fire runs down to the plains and ash falls on every town in the world.

cards.art: A volcano erupting over a walled kingdom, wizards in a ring of fire, painterly.

cards.title: Dig the ruins of {ruin}
cards.pitch: Under the ash of {ruin} the kingdom left tools, timber and iron. Give me a pair of hands for a season.

if_taken.say: The diggers bring up the kingdom's tools from {ruin}.

if_expires.say: Ash settles deeper over {ruin}. People ask why nobody digs.

cards.art: Grey-clad people digging tools out of ash-covered ruins, painterly.

cards.title: Hunt in the grey woods
cards.pitch: Some beasts lived through the fire. A hunting party brings meat, and maybe a lost family with it.

if_taken.say: The hunters come back with meat and a family that lived in the woods.

if_expires.say: Hungry people grumble in the tents.

cards.art: Hunters with spears in a grey, burned forest, painterly.

cards.title: A fire falls from the sky
cards.pitch: A star fell past the ash hills last night, burning. It did not break. Let me find where it came down.
cards.hint: Something falls from a sky full of ash.

if_taken.say: Wren finds a great ship of iron in a crater, still warm. Something moves inside.

if_expires.say: Everyone saw it fall. Nobody went to look, and they talk of nothing else.

cards.art: A smoking iron ship half-buried in a crater of ash, a lone scout, painterly.

cards.title: Kneel to the angel at {star}
cards.pitch: The thing in {star} is an angel sent to end the ash. Let the tribe kneel to it and bring it what we have.

if_taken.say: The Star-Folk step out and take the tribe's gifts. They build a strange city round their ship and send you light.

if_expires.say: The Star-Folk build a strange city round their ship. They do not know you.

cards.art: Grey-clad tribe kneeling before tall pale figures by a glowing ship, painterly.

cards.title: Strip the fallen star at {star}
cards.pitch: That ship is more iron than the kingdom ever had. Send diggers and spears, and take it before whatever is inside wakes.

if_taken.say: Your diggers strip the hull. The Star-Folk who live build walls round what is left, and watch you.

if_expires.say: The diggers say the iron hums at night. Nobody goes.

cards.art: Diggers cutting plates from a giant iron hull, pale figures watching, painterly.

abilities.name: Fire ward
abilities.text: Cast it over the town. For 75 seconds lava, fire and raiders stop at its edge, 26 paces from where you cast it. Lava piling against it wears it down. If it wears down too fast, it gives way.
abilities.look: a dome of sparks over the houses, and lava parting round it

events.title: Lava comes down the mountain
events.how: Lava is running down toward the town. Raise the Fire ward over the houses.

rules.name: The wizards' first working
rules.why: the wizards at {a} tried their first working on the mountain

rules.name: Tribute to the crown
rules.why: {count} towns of the kingdom send tribute to the court: +{n} Materials

rules.name: The wizards' ambition
rules.why: the wizards' gifts and plans grow again

rules.name: Scavengers
rules.why: the tribe picks over {count} ruins: +{n} Materials

rules.name: Light from the Star City
rules.why: the Star City sends its light: +{n} Magic

wants: The Star City as a home with sites of its own (draft 8 gives it the same 20 sites as any town: a keep yard, a harbour).
